verdict.rationale: Filee documents no scheduler for recurring jobs, meaning no time-based or cron-style runs. Watch folders [filee-docs-27] are an event-triggered automation that fires when files arrive, which is an adjacent feature rather than scheduled recurring workflows. The scriptable CLI [filee-docs-25, filee-docs-26] could be scheduled with an external OS task scheduler, but that is a host-platform workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
